mapper.select: SELECT checkin_id, lesson_id, student_id, dept_id, checkin_time, create_by, create_time FROM biz_lesson_checkin WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO biz_lesson_checkin (lesson_id, student_id, dept_id, checkin_time, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{lessonId}, #{studentId}, #{deptId}, #{checkinTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id, u.nick_name AS student_name, s.student_no, s.class_code, s.remark, c.checkin_id, c.lesson_id, c.dept_id, c.checkin_time, c.create_by, c.create_time FROM biz_student s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN biz_lesson_checkin c ON c.student_id = s.student_id AND c.lesson_id = #{lessonId} WHERE u.dept_id = #{deptId} AND s.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND s.class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.checkin_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, c.checkin_time ASC, CAST(s.student_no AS UNSIGNED) ASC, s.student_no ASC, s.student_id ASC

SELECT s.class_code, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.checkin_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS checked_in_count FROM biz_student s INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.dept_id = #{deptId} LEFT JOIN biz_lesson_checkin c ON c.student_id = s.student_id AND c.lesson_id = #{lessonId} WHERE s.entry_year = #{entryYear} GROUP BY s.class_code ORDER BY CAST(s.class_code AS UNSIGNED) ASC, s.class_code ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM biz_lesson_checkin WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId}
